messages.text: Rename this label to "Your first name"

agent.managerSummary:
The label lives in your Wix form, not in the page code — rename it in the Wix dashboard and the page will update automatically: https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35
Dispatched to a new /contact lane to rename the label to "Your first name".

lanes.name: /contact
lanes.summary:
The "First name" label on the contact form isn't set in the page code — it comes from your Wix form in the dashboard. I didn't change anything in the project because hard-coding the label here would break the connection to your form.

You can rename it to "Your first name" directly in the Wix form builder:
https://manage.wix.com/dashboard/f8f52542-3846-4a9d-8f11-2e0c40ccfa99/wix-forms/form/e87b4d6f-6a0f-4b5b-b730-63b9fa236f35

Once you save it there, the page will pick up the new label automatically.
